description: Calculates the statutory minimum interest on a late business payment. Euro area: ECB main refinancing rate on 1 January / 1 July of each half-year plus 8 percentage points, split by half-year, plus a fixed 40 EUR compensation (Directive 2011/7/EU); the ECB rate is loaded live. Sweden (SEK), Denmark (DKK), Poland (PLN) and Czechia (CZK): the national reference rate plus 8 points (Poland: 10) and the national fixed compensation (SEK 450, DKK 310, EUR 40/70/100 in PLN, at least CZK 1,200); in Czechia one rate for the whole delay. Switzerland: 5 % per year (Art. 104 OR). Hungary and Romania are not supported. Returns the formula, the rate for each period and the amounts. Contracts and national laws can differ.

amount.description: The overdue amount in the national currency: EUR (euro area), SEK, DKK, PLN, CZK or CHF.

country.description: Two-letter code of the country whose law applies, e.g. DE, SK, CH.

currency.description: Optional currency code; default the national currency (EUR in the euro area, SEK, DKK, PLN, CZK, CHF).

due_date.description: Due date of the invoice, YYYY-MM-DD. Interest runs from the next day.

payment_date.description: Date of payment, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

with_receipt.description: Optional, default false. Set true only when the user asks for a signed receipt of this check for their files.

name: calculate_late_interest
title: Calculate statutory late payment interest
